scope: RAF saved Train/Validation only; zero inference, training, remote calls, Test payload reads, baseline mutation or automation changes
selection_basis: Previously reported Validation metric-specific frontiers; also report all six external models, no selection on this new analysis or Test
pairing: Exact target_id/entity/seq/date/truth/gap/observed history; identical target order across models and seeds; retain all rows
provenance: Verify execution receipt -> split worker/receipt -> prediction manifest -> shards; unchanged model state; original validation checkpoint and source/input/runtime bindings; hash before and after
history_input: Only pure Train/Validation parquet d805cad0242078fedfbb87eed18bde9b73d37bfc9b93c6b75aac49087244efa2; mirror frozen84 context without importing model/loader
primary_difference: CNN loss minus external loss; positive means external better. AE and SE ordering for the same row must agree. Differences of aggregate MAE/RMSE need not agree.
error_localization: gross positive and negative AE/SE contributions
Train CNN pooled-seed AE90 fixed cutoff: both high/CNN only high/external only high/neither
fixed target quantity bins2,30,60,200 (descriptive, unavailable at prediction time)
history_conditions: Reuse previous fixed15 pattern/magnitude cells (PLAN0708d991be70c3792af95e6266005de2c9cea14d6851fc5aaa731351727ed8b3), plus observed history length1-2/3-10/>10, Train quartiles of last observed quantity and history CV, and last quantity versus history mean sign. Quartile ties retain original inequalities. Report every cell, not only favorable cells.
weights: Report row weights and common-entity-equal weights per cell across Train/Validation. Each retained entity total mass1. No exact history matching or false claim that joint distributions are controlled.
descriptive_signal: For a primary comparator, a history-only cell has positive CNN-minus-external AE and SE in both splits, all3 seeds, both weighting schemes, and minimum support. Passing localizes a reproducible descriptive deficit; it does not prove a backbone cause or authorize new training.
decision: Recommend a new backbone experiment only if the deficit links to a specific information-processing limitation, distinguishes a new mechanism/control from prior work, and makes a falsifiable prediction. Otherwise stop automatic structural search. Do not manufacture a model from a favorable subgroup.
limitations: Validation already used in earlier development
Repeated targets across seeds are not new independent samples
Train fit is descriptive, not generalization
Model-source/optimization/capacity differences may explain predictions; saved errors cannot identify causation
No p-values or statistical significance claims
No oracle routing presented as a deployable model
